sample: Hash-ordered BEIR test qrels; no shared gold document IDs or token-Jaccard >=0.8 claim variants across selected queries. Full shared retrieval corpus is intentional; source-topic independence and pretraining absence are unknown.
candidatePool: Full 5183-abstract corpus, application BM25 query/title+abstract scores, top six positive lexical candidates. No gold candidate injection or sentence selection using labels.
reranker: Pinned ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2, exact claim/title+abstract, one pair CPU, 512-token no-truncation bound. Any unscored candidate retains full query baseline order. No fitting or thresholds.
metrics: Document/whole-abstract relevance Recall@1/3/6, full-list MRR, nDCG@1/3/6 using supplied qrels. Unjudged documents treated as zero only for standard benchmark metrics, not proof of irrelevance. Not NLI or factual accuracy.
adoption: Only optional experimental relevance ordering if validation MRR and nDCG@3 improve and Recall@6 unchanged. No default enablement or authoritative stance promotion. Held-out reported once without retuning. English scientific abstracts do not validate Wikipedia/news/multilingual accuracy.
